title: feat(spec,objectql): report a caller value a stored expression replaced, as DroppedFieldsEvent reason stored_expression
body:
Closes #24690
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What

PR #24673 (`c0803b04d2`) made the engine compute a stored (non-`formula`) field's declared `expression` on every write, so a value the caller sends for such a field never stands. Before this PR nothing said so. `onFieldsDropped` stayed silent, so the PATCH and `/batch` doors answered with no `droppedFields`, and a flow's `update_record` reported success over a row that holds the computed value.

Scope follows the maintainer's ruling 「甲」 (#6015 comment 6292005854, applied on decision card #24854): in 18.x only the loud half ships. That half is the new `reason` value, its emit, and its report. The `strictReadonlyWrites` refusal is runtime behaviour that no conversion can carry, so it waits for 19.0.

- **spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`): `DroppedFieldsEventSchema.reason` gains `stored_expression`, with its describe. The field IS written, with the computed value in place of the caller's, so `computed` (a `formula` with no column, whose key is dropped) would be untrue of it. The name follows the existing arms, which name the field's role (`primary_key`, `computed`). The `fields` describe and the schema describe now also cover a field written with the computed value. In `contracts/data-engine.ts`, the `strictReadonlyWrites` TSDoc names `stored_expression` as the one arm outside its coverage in 18.x.
- **objectql** (`engine.ts`): `replacedStoredExpressionFields` reports a field when three things hold: the caller sent it, no other strip took it, and the value stored differs from the caller's. It runs on insert (single, batch, and `insertMany`'s per-row `droppedFields`), on update by id and on predicate update, in every context, `isSystem` included. A client that sends the computed value (the console grid's consistent save) or no value is told nothing. A value a static `readonly` strip already took is reported once, as `readonly`.
- **strictReadonlyWrites is unchanged.** The update path sends the report through a listener-only channel (`notifyDrop`). On insert, the strict check judges only the strips' own drops. Both strict checks sit exactly where they sit on `main`, before the computation. So a strict write whose only drop is a `stored_expression` replacement completes with the computed value and is reported to `onFieldsDropped`. A strict write that also carries a refusable drop is refused for that drop alone, writes nothing, and fires no listener. `readonly-strict-errors.ts` gains only the `REASON_PHRASE` row its exhaustive key type requires. No refusal carries that row in 18.x.
- **service-automation** (`crud-nodes.ts`): `DROPPED_REASON_LABEL` is an exhaustive `Record` over the reason union, so it needs the new row. For this reason the step warning says the requested value(s) were NOT stored, and that the write succeeded with the computed value(s). The other reasons keep their exact text.
- **Generated**: `content/docs/references/**` regenerated with `check:generated --fix`.
- **Changeset**: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/objectql` are `minor`, `@objectstack/service-automation` is `patch`. Not breaking. It records that the strict refusal is deferred to 19.0 per 「甲」.

## Landing order: the objectui pin must move first

objectui's `STRIPPED_LINE` (`packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts`) is a `Record` keyed by `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']`. `app-shell` builds with `tsc`, and `scripts/build-console.sh` installs this tree's `@objectstack/*` into the pinned objectui. The pin on `main` today is `616df6598b`. It does not contain objectui PR 13233 (objectstack-ai/objectui#13178), which adds the `stored_expression` row ahead of the spec pin: merge commit `8803ca54ac269643101f98dd0cc24ab25feb55a0`, which is 36 commits ahead of `616df6598b` and is on objectui `main`. Landing this PR at today's pin would turn the full-battery `Console Pin Gate` red.

The pin is not bumped here. `docs/releases-maintenance.md` says the pin moves by hand, in its own PR, with `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, to a revision chosen in an objectstack issue. **This PR must not land before that pin PR does.** The pin PR must:

1. Run `scripts/bump-objectui.sh 8803ca54ac269643101f98dd0cc24ab25feb55a0` (or a later objectui `main` commit). It writes `.objectui-sha` and the `@objectstack/console` changeset for `616df6598b..NEW`.
2. Regenerate the committed manifest in the same PR: `pnpm objectui:build`, then `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`. That rewrites `sdui.manifest.json` and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, and `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` must be green.
3. Land before this PR. The objectui row is keyed by the spec union plus `stored_expression`, so the pinned objectui compiles against `main`'s spec both before and after this PR.

## Tests (on the head named in the latest report)

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-stored-expression-dropped-fields.test.ts` covers by-id update (the PATCH door and each by-id `/batch` op), insert single, batch and `insertMany`, and predicate update. It has controls for an equal value and an unsent value, and checks the single report when the `readonly` strip took the value. Under `strictReadonlyWrites` it checks three things. By id, on insert and on a predicate update, the write completes and is reported. A write that also has a `readonly_when` drop is refused for that drop alone, writes nothing and fires no listener. An insert with a refusable drop is refused before the computation, carrying no `stored_expression` drop.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-stored-expression-dropped-fields.test.ts` runs through the composed stack (`RestServer`, then the protocol, then `ObjectQL`, then a real `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3). PATCH answers `droppedFields` and the `X-ObjectStack-Dropped-Fields` header. `/batch` tags the op index. Each has a consistent-value control.
- `crud-dropped-fields.test.ts` (service-automation) pins the new warning. `data-engine.test.ts` (spec) pins the five-value enum.
- Two ablations, one-time and with no test file left behind, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The tool restored and verified the file each time (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty).
  - The reporter's guard was forced to `return []`, and 12 of 30 objectql tests failed (first round).
  - The by-id `notifyDrop` was routed back through the strict-or-listener `emitDrop`, and the strict by-id report test failed (1 of 17).
- Reverse type check (first round): with the `stored_expression` row commented out of `DROPPED_REASON_LABEL`, service-automation `tsc` failed with TS2741.

## Acceptance notes

- `Object.is` is the comparison, as in the compute passes, over caller values normalized before the snapshot. Take a stored expression whose computed value has a different JS type from an equal value the caller sends, such as a date expression computing a `Date` against an ISO string: it would be reported. This was not measured.
- The `ImportRowResult.droppedFields` (`api/export`), `/batch` and protocol `droppedFields` describes still say "caller-supplied fields the engine LEGALLY strips". They carry the fifth reason through the shared enum, and their prose was left alone because it is outside this card's file surface.
- The 19.0 half, refusing a `stored_expression` replacement under `strictReadonlyWrites`, needs its own card, filed by the seat.
